class.name: CgameMockPlatformBackend
class.brief_description: In-memory platform backend that reproduces console-style failure modes.
class.description: [CgameMockPlatformBackend] keeps saves in memory and is meant for tests and for exercising the failure handling of game code on any machine: storage quota, interrupted writes, suspend, sign-out, controller loss and scripted platform keyboard input. Like console save containers it charges the new data on top of what already exists. [method CgamePlatformBackend.write_save] returns [constant CgamePlatformServices.SAVE_SUSPENDED] while suspended. User [code]"user1"[/code] is signed in and paired with controller device [code]0[/code].

method.name: corrupt_main
method.description: Overwrites the main copy of [param slot] with garbage to simulate a torn write or a disk fault.

members.member: Texts returned by [method CgamePlatformBackend.request_text_input], consumed in order. When the list is empty the request fails. Results are clamped to the requested maximum length.
